_doc: The MediaPipe person detector's answer on docs/bus.jpg, recorded from the OpenCV zoo's mp_persondet.MPPersonDet._postprocess run verbatim. rows are the zoo's own return value: each row is box[4] + landmarks[8] + score[1], post-NMS, at the zoo demo's thresholds. 2254 candidates is the SSD anchor count -- the same 2254 tools/pack/packers/mppose.py generates from the graph's three DepthToSpace levels. COVERAGE IS PARTIAL AND THAT IS THE MODEL: at scoreThreshold=0.5 this frame keeps ONE person, with raw scores over all anchors of 0.854, 0.305, 0.067 and 0.065, so two people YOLOv8n-pose would find sit below the threshold the zoo chose. That is recorded in models/mediapipe-pose/CHECKPOINT.json too, and it is not a defect to be fixed by lowering the threshold here -- the golden has to be the answer the reference implementation gives. The one adapter: cv2 5.0.0 returns the two Concat outputs in the reverse order to the one _postprocess documents, so they are sorted by trailing dimension before the zoo sees them; no arithmetic is edited.
